instructions: Slice the halloumi 1/4 inch thick into about 12 slices and pat them dry. Slice the tomatoes into 1/4-inch rounds and the cucumbers into thin rounds. Pick 1/4 cup mint leaves.
Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the halloumi in a single layer, working in two batches if it doesn't all fit. You don't need more oil for the second batch.
Cook the halloumi for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until deep golden brown. Transfer it to a plate.
Warm the pitas in the same skillet for 20 seconds per side.
Fill each pita with the halloumi, then the tomato, cucumber and mint. Fold it over. Serve right away.
method_notes: No grilled halloumi pita page has 20 ratings. The Meatwave's grilled halloumi pita sandwiches (no rating shown) lead: halloumi in 1/4-inch slices, browned hard, tucked into warm pita with tomato. Chef in Disguise's halloumi wraps (no rating) add the mint, and Myriad Recipes' halloumi sandwich (5 from 1) shows pan-frying. The lead's red onion, lettuce and tzatziki are left out, and cucumber comes from the list's line. Halloumi is already salty, so there's no added salt.
